status: native KiCad board audit; not electrical or fabrication acceptance

resistance_model.copper_thickness_status: 35um candidate only; no fabricator stackup agreed
resistance_model.meaning: Sum of ALL segment resistances in a net gives a conservative trace-only series bound once KiCad proves connectivity; parallel branches reduce actual resistance. It is not a voltage-drop simulation. Via barrel/contact/pad/constriction/temperature effects omitted; zero-connectivity proof is separate.
resistance_model.GND: Zone return impedance and ground bounce not modeled
resistance_model.thermal: No temperature rise or LED thermal qualification inferred from this calculation

via_in_solder_land_requirement: These vias intersect solder lands: resin fill and copper cap / planarization process must be agreed and qualified with fabricator and assembler; ordinary open through-vias are not acceptable production substitution. Four QFN exposed-pad vias also require stencil qualification.

ground_reference_check.boundary: Connected copper island is a geometric test, not high-frequency return-path or ground-bounce qualification.

decoupling_layout_boundary.measurement: Native pad and segment coordinates. Split branches may divide this segment without changing its copper. No package ESL, capacitor impedance, trace inductance or switching transient has been measured.
decoupling_layout_boundary.qualification_required: Scope VLED/VCC/VCAP at IC under maximum changing image; current limited 3mA first light precedes 20mA tests.
